stem_book: If z = x + iy lies in the second quadrant and θ = tan⁻¹|y/x| (the acute angle), then arg(z) is: (a) θ (b) −θ (c) π − θ (d) θ − π
reason: print never defines θ; added the standard assumption θ = tan⁻¹|y/x| so the question has one answer
work: second quadrant: x < 0, y > 0 → arg z = π − tan⁻¹|y/x| = π − θ
